featured_reviews.name: velita athayde
featured_reviews.review_text:
My uncle, Francis Dsouza, passed away just 16 days after being admitted to your home. This raises serious questions that the family deserves answers to.

How did his condition deteriorate to such an extent within such a short period? If he was struggling to adjust to the environment, why was the family not informed immediately?

Is it not the responsibility of the home to closely monitor new admissions, particularly during the initial adjustment period, and communicate any concerns to the family? Had we been informed of any difficulties, we could have taken appropriate action.

It is deeply concerning that there appears to have been no timely intervention or notification. A facility entrusted with the care of vulnerable individuals should have clear protocols in place to assess whether residents are adapting well to their surroundings.

There should be a policy that permits long-term stay only when a resident is demonstrably adjusting to the environment and their well-being is being maintained. The lack of communication and apparent failure to identify or address these issues has left our family shocked, disappointed, and seeking accountability.

featured_reviews.name: ROHAN MAHADIK
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting the New Life Foundation Old Age Home to celebrate a special birthday, and it was such a delightful experience. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with open arms by the wonderful caretakers, Rajesh Moro and Sarita Moro. Their warmth and kindness made me feel instantly at home.

The love and affection I received from everyone there was truly heartwarming. ensuring that each person is not only well taken care of but also truly loved. The residents, who come from all sorts of backgrounds and cultures, were so lively and engaged. We laughed, shared stories, and enjoyed every moment together it felt like one big, happy family.

The home itself is beautifully kept, with a serene and peaceful atmosphere that makes it a perfect place for the elderly to live out their golden years. There’s a genuine sense of community and care that just radiates from every corner of the place.

Out of all the old age homes I’ve visited, New Life Foundation is by far the most loved and enjoyable. The attention, care, and love each resident receives here are truly special. If you’re looking for a place where your loved ones will be cherished and cared for, I can’t recommend New Life Foundation enough.

featured_reviews.name: Dhruv Raja
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited this old age home and had a wonderful experience. The place was clean, peaceful, and filled with warmth. All the elderly people were so friendly and welcoming — it truly felt like a big family. A beautiful place spreading love and care! 💛

featured_reviews.name: YASH Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting this old age trust was one of the most emotional and inspiring experiences of my life. In a world where people often forget the value of our elders, this foundation stands as a symbol of love, care, and humanity. The way the staff members treat every senior with respect, patience, and affection truly touched my heart. It is not just a place for the elderly — it’s a home filled with warmth, laughter, and dignity.

Every corner of the trust reflects the effort and dedication of the people working here. The environment is peaceful and positive, and you can feel the happiness on the faces of the residents. They are not just being taken care of — they are being given a family again. The management deserves special appreciation for maintaining such high standards of cleanliness, safety, and emotional support.

What impressed me most is how the foundation goes beyond basic care — they engage the residents in activities, celebrations, and conversations that bring them joy and purpose. These small acts create a big difference in their lives. It’s heartwarming to see that the elderly here are not lonely; they are surrounded by compassion and understanding.

I truly believe that this trust is doing a noble service to society. Every person working here deserves immense respect for their dedication to such a meaningful cause. Supporting such organizations reminds us of our duty to give back to those who once gave everything to us.

I wholeheartedly appreciate the work being done here and hope more people come forward to volunteer, support, and spread awareness about this beautiful initiative. This foundation is not just an old age home — it’s a home filled with hope, care, and love. 🌼

featured_reviews.name: Tejash Upadhyay
featured_reviews.review_text:
New Life Foundation Old Age Home is a truly caring and well-managed place for senior citizens. The staff members are compassionate, patient, and always attentive to the residents’ needs. The environment is peaceful, clean, and filled with positivity — just like a real home.

They organize regular health checkups, recreational activities, and cultural programs to keep everyone active and happy. The food is nutritious and hygienic, and the facilities are well-maintained. What stands out most is the warmth and emotional support the elders receive here.

Overall, New Life Foundation Old Age Home is not just a shelter for the elderly, but a community that gives them dignity, comfort, and companionship. Highly recommended for families looking for a safe and loving home for their loved ones. ❤️

description: Yuva Parivartan is one of the largest non-profit livelihood & skill development initiatives in the country operating in 18 states. Yuva Parivartan focuses on a segment of society that remains relatively ignored in spite of the increased focus on skills training and development in the country. This segment comprises mainly of out-of-school youth with little education and, thus, few or no livelihood opportunities. Yuva Parivartan provides relatively short-term training courses to such youth & enables them to contribute to the society. Yuva Parivartan is a National Skills Development Corporation (NSDC) Partner & one of the few national level NGOs with a proven, scalable & replicable model for skills development & employment.

name: JKP Care Foundation
description:
Welcome to the compassionate world of Jaikripalu Prabhu Care Foundation, Established as a government-registered NGO, our foundation is dedicated to making a positive impact in the lives of children and adults with special needs through our multifaceted initiatives.

At the heart of our mission is "Spandan," our residential Rehabilitation Unit designed to provide holistic care and support for special needs children and adults. In addition to our residential unit, we have extended our reach to the digital realm through our online training institute. Collaborating with the prestigious Cambridge International Institute for Professional Development (CIIPD), we offer a range of online courses tailored to meet the unique needs of today.

We truly appreciate your trust in JKP Care Foundation and wish you continued success in your work.

I huge thank  to Dr. Alok and his team. The entire team comprises of dedicated professionals working to a great cause.

Thank you, JKP Foundation, for making such a positive impact.

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Maunthrooa
featured_reviews.review_text:
My journey with JKP Care Foundation has been one of exploration and discovery. Since meeting Dr Alok in Mauritius (sharing a flag-raising ceremony together at the Angel Special School and Welfare Association) and listening to one of his sessions conducted for parents of learners with disabilities and special education needs, I have had the opportunity to follow his great work and attend various online sessions. These have allowed me to explore other avenues, broaden my perspectives and get solutions to various issues touching those learners with special needs. It is said that we keep on learning at any age and this is what I am going through. Well done Dr Alok and team. Continue with the same enthusiasm 👌
Regards, Deepak Maunthrooa (Quality Assurance Officer at the Special Education Needs Authority in the Republic of Mauritius).
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much, Deepak Maunthrooa Sir, for your thoughtful and inspiring words.
We are truly honored by your journey with JKP Care Foundation and deeply grateful for your kind appreciation. It means a great deal to us that our interactions—from the memorable time in Mauritius at the Angel Special School and Welfare Association to the online sessions—have contributed to broadening perspectives and offering practical solutions for learners with special needs.

Your belief in lifelong learning and your continued engagement are truly motivating. On behalf of JKP entire team, thank you for your encouragement, trust, and gracious support. We remain committed to serving with the same enthusiasm and dedication.
